review_scope: Four selected pages visually compared with extracted page text. This is a spot check, not an extraction accuracy estimate or review of all redactions.

reviews.document_type_observation: Photograph page with visible redactions and an EFTA stamp
reviews.finding: Sparse extracted text is consistent with the photographic content; a low-text flag alone does not demonstrate failed OCR.
The extracted text preserves visible report and contact date labels. Identifying fields are visibly redacted.
Page contains multiple dates and transcript line numbers. Extracted text has recognition artifacts. A document date cannot be chosen by taking the first date match.

reviews.document_type_observation: Email layout with To, From and Subject labels, redacted participant fields, and an inline date
reviews.finding: The strict From-then-To-plus-Date-or-Sent detector returns zero candidates. This is a known false negative caused by header order and an inline date; redacted identities cannot be reconstructed from these labels.
